(Currently Amended) Claim 1: An immunogenic composition comprising: a modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus type lb (BVDV-lb), __a veterinary-acceptable carrier,__ and optionally an adjuvant.

(Original) Claim 2: The immunogenic composition of claim 1, wherein the modified, live bovine viral diarrhea virus is a cytopathic BVDV-lb virus.

(Original) Claim 3: The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising one or more of a parainfluenza virus Type 3 (PI3), a bovine respiratory syncytial virus (BRSV), a bovine herpes virus (BHV-1), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type la (BVDV-la), a bovine viral diarrhea virus Type 2 (BVDV-2), or an infectious bovine rhinotracheitis (IBR) virus, or any combination thereof; or one or more viral-specific antigens obtained therefrom.

(Original) Claim 4: The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising __at least one__ modified, live IBRV, __at least one__ modified, live BRSV, __at least one__ modified, live BHV-1, __at least one__ modified, live BVDV Type la, __at least one__ modified, live BVDV Type 2, or __at least one__ modified, live PI3, or a combination thereof.

(Currently Amended) Claim 6: The immunogenic composition of claim 1, further comprising an immunologically effective amount of __at least one__ first antigen.

(Original) Claim 7: The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is specific for an organism selected from the group consisting of Actinobacillus, Actinomyces, Bacillus, Bordetella, Brachyspira, Campylobacter, Clostridium, Ehrlichia, Erysipelothrix, Escherichia, Histophilus, Leptospira, Listeria, Mannheimia, Moraxella, Mycobacterium, Mycoplasma, Pasteurella, Salmonella, and Streptococcus, or a combination thereof.

(Original) Claim 8: The immunogenic composition of claim 6, wherein the at least a first antigen is inactivated.

(Currently Amended) Claim 12: The vaccine of claim 4, further comprising an immunologically-effective amount of __at least one__ microbial pathogen-specific antigen.
